digest.component_or_area: RP-02 through RP-06 recovered janitor plan approval derisk
propositions: Five recovered approved-but-lossy RP decisions (RP-02 through RP-06) require evidence-backed research briefs that clarify architectural intent, preserve hard-won bug/test behavior, and resolve implementation-critical ambiguities before creation of implementation stories.

RP-02 owns ordered exact-match retirement recovery at an explicit live-operation boundary with three-entity identity overlap validation and no-op repeat semantics, while RP-03 consumes coherent post-recovery snapshot and owns TicketPlan orchestration without duplicating persistence recovery.

RP-03 requires singular retry ownership with two-level pattern separating concrete adapter request-replay from backend-neutral reconciler operation intent and postcondition re-observation, using scoped finite-pass fuse and `commit_unknown` for writes with lost responses.

RP-04 consolidates explicit precedence (CLI > environment > project > user > default), per-operation snapshot with separate secret/provider boundary, and fail-closed malformed-config behavior, while correcting CLI-over-environment tracker precedence and removing Cloud adapter-local fallback.

RP-05 and RP-06 require decision on help-system normalization and parity-first failure projection respectively, with RP-06 explicitly approving effective applicability reversal and effective built-in/project-DET routing that were deliberate behaviors now being intentionally changed.

All behavior changes must be explicitly named as approved deltas in implementation stories rather than hidden under "parity"; preserved hard-won invariants include snapshot omission is never deletion, only bounded direct-GET 404s advance grace, and confirmed-deletion no-resurrection.
